description: List every active session and every tombstoned (recently-killed but reserved) sessionId. Tombstones are reservations: the shell is gone but the sessionId can still be called against — doing so respawns a fresh shell under the same id and surfaces the original termination reason (shell-exit, idle-killed, or evicted). Tombstones expire after 30 days; after that the id is gone.
name: terminal_list
title: List terminal sessions
